description: This Java class 'DittoProtocolAdapterProvider' extends 'ProtocolAdapterProvider' and provides a protocol adapter specifically for the Ditto protocol. It includes constructor initialization of the adapter, and methods to retrieve the adapter and create HTTP header translators based on configuration.

classes.name: DittoProtocolAdapterProvider
classes.description: A provider class for the Ditto protocol adapter, extending ProtocolAdapterProvider and responsible for instantiating and providing configured ProtocolAdapter instances.

methods.name: DittoProtocolAdapterProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the protocol adapter and calls the superclass constructor with protocol configuration.

methods.name: getProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Returns the pre-initialized Ditto protocol adapter, optionally based on user agent.

methods.name: createHttpHeaderTranslatorInstance
methods.description: Creates a HeaderTranslator instance for HTTP headers, filtering out blocked headers as specified in the ProtocolConfig.
